messages:
toni (Marketing): Planning to publish the Mosaic launch post next Wed 09:00am PT. Need final changelog, canonical docs URL, bench blurb (1 para + 3 bullets), and a webhook for inbound lead capture by EOD Mon.
kai (Eng): Changelog PR almost done (#9152). I'll add canary rollout notes and the exact rollout-time window we used in staging.
rachel (Docs): I can stand up /docs/mosaic-release with migration steps and examples as soon as Kai drops the config snippet. Please avoid linking to PR previews; we need a stable URL.
omar (Product): Webinar set for Fri 10am PT. Marketing wants a one-line teaser for the registration and three bullets for the slide deck (latency/cost/resilience). Also want the lead capture webhook so Registrations -> SFDC flow is tested.
kai (Eng): Bench draft: "Mosaic reduces tail latency on long-context prompts by ~22% while reducing per-token cost by ~25% with batching and improved kernel selection. The release includes an optional prefix cache for steady-session performance and clearer Dedicated migration steps."
kai (Eng): Bullets: 1) ~22% tail latency reduction (16k context), 2) ~25% per-token cost savings via smarter batching and kernel selection, 3) optional prefix-cache for stable p95 on heavy sessions.
toni (Marketing): Nice. Can you trim the paragraph to ~40 words for the promo and drop the bullet list in this thread? We also need a 1-sentence caption for the webinar invite.
kai (Eng): Promo paragraph (40w): "Mosaic cuts tail latency on long-context LLMs by ~22% and lowers per-token inference cost ~25% through smarter batching and kernel tuning; includes optional prefix-caching for consistent session performance."
toni (Marketing): Perfect. Webinar caption: "See Mosaic in action: faster responses, lower costs — live demo and migration tips."
rachel (Docs): I'll publish /docs/mosaic-release and post the canonical link here by tomorrow AM.
omar (Product): For rollout timing: Eng suggests a staged canary over 3 hours with a 10% initial traffic shift then 50% at hour 1 if metrics stable. Kai, confirm exact times and the rollback command for the post.
kai (Eng): Confirmed: canary plan + rollback CLI in changelog. Will paste the CLI snippet tonight.
toni (Marketing): Last item: inbound lead webhook. Ops, can we get a test webhook endpoint (staging) for the registration flow so we can validate mapping to SFDC?
deploy-bot: Docs deploy scheduled: mosaic-release -> staging at 2026-04-02T05:00:00Z.
omar (Product): I'll coordinate with GTM ops for the webhook test. Toni, once docs URL and webhook are here, marketing will lock the post and schedule the announcement. :rocket:
